name: kestrel-bank-demo
description: Investor demo of a digital banking platform. Runs locally; all money, cards and data are simulated.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @kestrel/api" "npm run dev -w @kestrel/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kestrel/shared && npm run build -w @kestrel/api && npm run build -w @kestrel/web
